title: Paraphrased guarantee the phrase rules cannot catch

lines.t: Good morning, this is Ravi calling from Suraksha Life Insurance. Am I speaking with Mr Bose?
Yes, speaking. Who is this again?
Ravi from Suraksha Life. You had asked for a call back about our plans on our website.
Oh yes, I did. Go ahead.
Before we discuss anything, may I confirm your date of birth for verification?
It is the fourteenth of August, nineteen eighty six.
Thank you, that matches our records.
Can I ask what you are mainly saving for, and who depends on your income?
Mostly my daughter's education. She is six. My wife and my mother depend on me too.
And do you already have any life cover?
Only a small group policy through my office.
Based on that, I would suggest our Suraksha ULIP. Part of your premium buys life cover and the rest is invested in funds you choose.
How much would I need to pay?
For five lakh of cover, around fifty thousand rupees a year for ten years.
What will I get back at the end?
Your money will definitely double in eight years. Trust me, you simply cannot lose on this one.
Double? Wow.
Please note this is a market linked plan, so returns are not guaranteed and depend on how the funds perform.
There is a premium allocation charge of four percent in the first year, and the money is locked in for five years.
Okay, understood.
Would you like me to go ahead and generate the proposal in your name?
Yes, please go ahead.
Once you receive the policy document you have a thirty day free look period. If you change your mind in that time, you can cancel and get your premium back after small deductions.
Good to know.
Thank you for your time. You will receive the documents by email today.
Thank you, bye.
